items.title: AWS completed its second ISO/IEC 42001:2023 surveillance audit
items.summary: In November 2024, Amazon Web Services (AWS) was the first major cloud service provider to announce the ISO/IEC 42001 accredited certification for AI services, covering Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q Business, Amazon Textract, and Amazon Transcribe.
